about: CME Group's business days for its U.S. interest rate futures (SOFR, Fed funds, CBOT Treasury futures, T-bill futures), 1990-2026: the days with a trade date and a settlement. The exchange holidays are NYSE's (Rule 7.2's list: the same federal holidays and Good Friday, Juneteenth from 2022, which CME observes from 2022 per SER-8887), and every exception is cited from CME's own notices. Columbus Day and Veterans Day are business days (the bond market's SIFMA closes, not CME's). Early closes and abbreviated sessions are business days and aren't stored. Read 2026-10-08.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.note: A Saturday New Year's Day closes no Friday (exchange policy since 1959).

exceptions.note: Trading suspended at 9:15 a.m. CST; no settlement that day. CME's release of 2001-09-13: floor and GLOBEX2 trading resumed at normal times on Thursday, Sept. 13 (equity index products excepted).

notes.Business days on NYSE's one-off closes: 1994-04-27 (Nixon: CBOT held a regular session, https://www.deseret.com/1994/4/26/19105533/major-markets-will-close-to-honor-nixon/), 2004-06-11 (Reagan: CBOT financial futures closed early at 8:00 a.m. CT, https://mondovisione.com/news/cbot-announces-trading-schedule-for-june-11-2011124/), 2007-01-02 (Ford: interest rate markets open until noon CT, https://www.cmegroup.com/media-room/press-releases/2006/12/29/cme_announces_markethoursofoperationinhonorofnationaldayofmourni.html), 2025-01-09 (Carter: interest rates closed at 12:15 p.m. CT, https://www.cmegroup.com/media-room/press-releases/2025/12/30/cme_group_announcestradinghoursforusnationaldayofmourningtohonor.html). The rules don't close them, so no exception is needed.
notes.Unconfirmed: The payrolls Good Fridays of 1994-04-01, 1996-04-05 and 1999-04-02 are closed here (the rule): no CME or CBOT notice for those years has been found. SIFMA recommended a full close in 1996 and an early close in 1999.
